summary: Harris County tower listed at 935 ft; a 1955 report names its operator at the William Mountain tower. No source describes the site today.

events.note: Idus T. Averett was stationed at the William Mountain tower, per a Columbus Ledger report dated October 29, 1955 and quoted by Forest Lookouts. Identity with the list's williams mtn is inferred.

corrections.why: The list tags this tower gfc-307, a GFC list number. The US prefix in the record has no basis in the source.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1955 report spells it William Mountain; the list has williams mtn. They are taken to be one tower, which no source states outright.

notes_for_editor: Identity: the 1955 William Mountain tower is taken to be the list's williams mtn (GA202, Harris, 935, gfc-307). No source says so outright, so the staffing event is only as firm as that link. Harris County also had a Harris Tower in 1955 (operator Henry M. Koone), and the list has other Harris County rows (GA023 Harris County Lookout Tower, GA034 Martins Knob, GA196 pine mtn, GA208 cataula). Do not merge them. The list's name is the author's own label. Status, build date, design, height, access and present condition are not in any source read, so they are left unknown. Confidence medium: one list row and one 1955 newspaper item quoted second-hand.
